abstract: The transition in mouse teratocarcinomas of pluripotential stem cells to histogenetically determined ones of the neurogenic cell lineage was analysed at the total cellular protein level by two-dimensional gel electrophoresis. The change in morphology and function was found to be reflected by extensive shifts in the protein synthesis patterns. From a total of about 1000 resolved polypeptides that are synthesized in embryoid bodies of a multidifferentiating teratocarcinoma, about 12% (117 proteins) are not found or only present at a very much reduced level in two teratocarcinoma-derived neuroblastomas. On the other hand, the change in phenotype is accompanied by the de novo or greatly enhanced synthesis of another 69 proteins (about 7%) in the neurogenic tumors. In a screening for differentiation-specific proteins this set was compared with the protein synthesized in neural tissue of maturing brain and muscle tissue of developing limbs at three different postimplantation stages covering the onset of organogenesis. This comparison disclosed that a great portion of the differentiation-related proteins (26 proteins) are synthesized in both brain and muscle and are probably required by a differentiated cell in general like cytostructural proteins. Seventeen polypeptides, however, are synthesized in a cell type specific manner. In particular, 4 proteins that are synthesized in both neurogenic tumors and in brain but not in muscle tissue were tentatively called nerve-specific proteins (NSP) and are the most promising in further analyses of differentiation-specific proteins.
abstract_ja: マウス奇形癌の多分化能を持つ幹細胞が、神経系の細胞系列へと決定される移行過程を、二次元ゲル電気泳動によって全細胞タンパク質レベルで解析した。形態と機能の変化は、タンパク質合成パターンの大きな変化として現れた。多分化型奇形癌の胚様体で合成される約1000種の分離ポリペプチドのうち、約12%（117種）は、2種の奇形癌由来神経芽腫では存在しないか、著しく減少していた。一方、神経系腫瘍では別の69種（約7%）が新たに合成されるか、著しく増加していた。分化関連タンパク質を探索するため、この群を、器官形成開始を含む3つの発生段階における成熟脳および発生中の肢の筋組織で合成されるタンパク質と比較した。その結果、分化関連タンパク質の多くは脳と筋の両方で合成されていた。17種のポリペプチドは細胞種特異的に合成されていた。特に、神経系腫瘍と脳で合成されるが筋組織では合成されない4種のタンパク質は、神経特異的タンパク質（NSP）と暫定的に命名され、分化特異的タンパク質の解析において最も有望であった。
